status: DRAFT — not frozen. Frozen copy and sha256 go in STAGE4-DECLARATION.md before any Stage 4 run.
staleGraceNote: A daily input is active when its latest usable value is dated at most staleGraceDays before D − lag (one missed publication tolerated). Daily bars: last bar ≥ D − 1 − staleGraceDays.
barsNote: Bar families (E1, E2, E6, T3) and the E3a trigger use row windows on Coinbase daily bars; the last 400 bars must be consecutive days, else these families are withheld. Daily-input staleness is date-based (lag + grace), not staleAfterSec.

e1.note: Each part mapped by percentile separately, then E1 = round(mean of the 3 mapped scores). Slope = (SMA20 today − SMA20 5 bars earlier) / ATR14 today. ATR = Wilder.

e2.note: V1 scripts/amt.js method verbatim: 80 equal bins over the 30-bar high-low range (STAGE4-PLAN §3 text said 0.25% bins — corrected to V1's actual method), VAH/VAL rounded to whole dollars, price = close of bar D−1 (V1 used live spot). TESTING_VAH/VAL score 0 as in V1 ('no accepted directional edge yet'). Flagged for the Board check.

e3a.note: Reading = mean of the 8 completed hourly closes of the Binance BTCUSDT premium index, ending at the evaluation hour (D 00:00 for the backtest and the frozen daily record; the last completed hour for intraday display). References = one per day, the same mean ending at that day's 00:00. Below p25: positive only if min(last 3 closes) > min(the 7 closes before); if daily bars are stale the family is withheld.

e5a.note: z = (median of the 24 completed hourly USDT-adjusted premiums ending at the evaluation hour − mean of the 30 prior UTC-day medians) / population sd; a day counts with ≥ 20 hours; ≥ 25 days needed. Score = clamp(round(z × 10/3), ±10).

e6.note: 30-day realised volatility = sample standard deviation (n − 1) of daily log returns × √365, percentile against all prior days; not a vote.

t3.note: Parts: (close − SMA200)/ATR14 and (SMA200 today − SMA200 20 bars earlier)/ATR14, each mapped by percentile, then round(mean).

t4.note: Calendar-based: g(d) = v(d)/v(d−30) − 1 and x(d) = g(d) − median g over (d−365, d−1] (≥ 300 values); x mapped by percentile.

scorecards.modifierOrder: mean of active families → round half away from zero → [V-E2: if E1 < 0, min(score, +2); V-E2 needs E1 active, else withheld] → round → [E6b: if E6 top decile, score / 2] → round → clamp ±10 → band

hashNote: declarationHash = sha256 of JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(file)) (not of the file bytes).
